user_intent: 期望 亮度 处于 404 lux
如果 人在家 那么 降低 声音
如果发生火灾，那么开始报警
如果发生火灾，那么打开逃生通道
人离开时，关闭所有影音、照明、环境控制及厨电类电器
standard_taps: IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() < 404 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN brightness_plus() aqara_LED_light
IF xiaomi_brightness_guard.brightness() > 404 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN brightness_minus() aqara_LED_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() < 404 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN brightness_plus() aqara_LED_light
IF xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.get_illuminance() > 404 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN brightness_minus() aqara_LED_light
IF generic_hood_version_1.reading() > 0.14 AND xiaomi_presence_sensor_pro.is_person_present() == true THEN power_on() generic_hood_version_1
